title: fix(cli): a --no-server boot takes the datasource admin routes' own degrade line, not an ordering fault
body:
Fixes #24022

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On a boot that composes no HTTP server, the boot diagnostics printed:

```
WARN [datasource-admin] route registration failed: [Kernel] Service 'http.server' not found (while plugin 'com.objectstack.cli.datasource-admin-routes' was initializing — a composition/ordering fault; registration order is not a contract.)
```

Nothing was at fault. `--no-server` composes no server on purpose. The plugin read the server with `ctx.getService?.('http.server') ?? ctx.getService?.('http-server')`. The kernel's `getService` throws on a name nothing registered (`packages/core/src/kernel.ts`, the `[Kernel] Service '...' not found` throw, with the init-order suffix from `describeInitOrderFault` in `plugin-order.ts`). So the `??` never ran. The throw landed in the registration `catch`, and the plugin's own degrade line was unreachable.

## The fix

`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` only, the `com.objectstack.cli.datasource-admin-routes` plugin:

- The plugin moves out of `run()` into an exported factory, `createDatasourceAdminRoutesPlugin(registerRoutes)`, next to `createUnknownHostnameGuardPlugin`. That makes its `init` reachable from a test against a real kernel. `run()` now calls `kernel.use(createDatasourceAdminRoutesPlugin(registerDatasourceAdminRoutes))`. Name, version and `optionalDependencies` are unchanged.
- `init` reads the server through the existing `readComposedHttpServer` (reused, not changed): `http.server` only, inside a `try`. No server: the plugin's own line, `[datasource-admin] http.server unavailable; REST routes not installed`. A server composed and registration throws: `route registration failed` with the error, as before.
- The old fallback to the deprecated `http-server` alias was never reached: the canonical read threw first. Every in-repo producer of `http-server` (the Hono server plugin and the http-conformance node plugin) also registers `http.server`, the same instance. So every boot that mounted these routes before still mounts them.
- `scripts/slot-lookup-baseline.json`: `serve.ts` 9 to 7, because the untyped two-lookup chain is gone (`check:slot-lookup` holds at 102 sites in 25 files).

## Pins

- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-datasource-admin-routes.test.ts` (unit tier, new). The plugin runs inside a real `ObjectKernel`, so the throw it has to survive is the kernel's own:
  1. premise: the kernel throws for an unregistered `http.server`;
  2. no server: no `route registration failed`, no `ordering fault`, exactly one `[datasource-admin]` line;
  3. only `http.server` is asked for, never the alias;
  4. CONTROL: a composed server gets the real routes, all under `/api/v1/datasources`, and no `[datasource-admin]` line;
  5. CONTROL: a composed server whose registration throws still warns `route registration failed`, naming the error;
  6. source pin, comments masked: `run()` mounts through the factory, and no second inline copy exists.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-no-server-banner.integration.test.ts` (integration tier), against the built CLI:
  - shapes 1 and 2 (production `--no-server --preset minimal`, and `--dev --no-server`) carry exactly one `[datasource-admin]` line, and it does not report a failed registration or an ordering fault;
  - shape 3 (a default boot) is the CONTROL: `/api/v1/datasources` is not 404, while an unmounted sibling path is 404, and no `[datasource-admin]` line prints;
  - shape 4 (`--no-server` with a config-mounted `HonoServerPlugin`) has the same control. It backs the changeset's claim that the routes still mount on that shape. This round adds it.

## Verification, all at head `a12bf2f9b`

- Unit tier: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` reads 309 files, 4588 tests, all passed, exit 0.
- Integration, the touched file: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 src/commands/serve-no-server-banner.integration.test.ts` reads 4 of 4 passed, exit 0. The other integration-tier files are declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exits 0, `check:test-typecheck` included. `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` compiles both touched test files.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed `.ts` files exits 0 with no output. The `.md` and `.json` files are outside eslint's configured file set.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 75 commands, and all 75 exit 0. `--ran` reads `75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
  - Three gates first refused with exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and were re-run green once the prerequisite was met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit fetched with `--depth=1`), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` (after a full `turbo run build`).
  - Also run, outside the derived set: `check:startup-registry-verdict` (exit 0, 45 seams, none recording a verdict the boot can contradict) and `check-nul-bytes` (exit 0).
- At the door, against the built CLI, `os serve objectstack.config.ts --no-server --preset minimal` on a host fixture prints `WARN [datasource-admin] http.server unavailable; REST routes not installed`, and no ordering fault.

### Ablation (once, on the changed behaviour)

The fix was committed first. The mutation, done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, puts the pre-fix read back: the throwing `getService` chain, inside the `try`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob went from `a48fc3da93e4` to `95b1a98c5f93`.

- Mutated leg: the CLI was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight @objectstack/cli 'readComposedHttpServer(ctx)' --absent` passed.
  - The unit file reads 1 failed, 5 passed. The failure is `takes its own degrade line`.
  - The integration file reads 2 failed, 2 passed. Shapes 1 and 2 failed, each showing the card's exact `route registration failed ... a composition/ordering fault` line. The two controls stayed green, as they should.
- Restore leg: blob back to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. The CLI was rebuilt, and the preflight found the marker present again. Unit 6 of 6 and integration 4 of 4 passed.
- Unit case 3 (only `http.server` asked) stays green under the mutation, because the old chain also never reached the alias once the canonical read threw. It guards against an alias read coming back. It does not discriminate this card's defect.

## Handover

This resumes the released claim's branch at `4b0a631575`. Every commit was re-read hunk by hunk:

- kept `7177b4e8c` (the fix, and the new unit file, which landed in this commit, not in `2e52e010a`), `2e52e010a` (the integration cases) and `16be28cdd` (the baseline row, re-measured after this round's merge of `origin/main` `50ccfa669`);
- corrected `acd285a2b`: the changeset's alias sentence now says the fallback never ran, instead of reading like a narrowing;
- added the shape 4 control.

All verification above was re-run in this round.

## Acceptance notes

- The same defect is in the sibling plugin in this file, the unknown-hostname guard. Its `init` reads `http.server` through the same throwing chain. Measured at the door: `OS_ROOT_DOMAIN=example.test os serve objectstack.config.ts --no-server --preset minimal` prints `WARN [unknown-hostname-guard] install failed {"error":"[Kernel] Service 'http.server' not found (while plugin 'com.objectstack.cli.unknown-hostname-guard' was initializing — a composition/ordering fault; ...)"}`. It is outside this claim's file surface, so it is not changed here. It goes to the seat as a finding.
- The new unit file imports `serve.ts`, and on this shared box that import costs about 18.8 s (tests 14 ms). A sibling that imports the same module (`serve-unknown-hostname-guard.test.ts`) measured the same in one run, 36.6 s of import across the two files. No budget line is declared, since none of the three budget classes fits. This is a reading, not a gate.
- `origin/main` moved to `c1c0a9094` after this branch's merge. The 3 commits touch `packages/rest`, `plugin-email`, `qa/dogfood`, `runtime` tests and `spec/liveness`, none of them under `packages/cli`. `git merge-tree` is clean, so they were not merged.
- `packages/runtime/README.md` shows a server plugin registering only the deprecated `http-server` alias. Docs drift, noted here, not filed.
